title: Testimony version (schema v1)
description: One testimony sitting. Immutable once entered; may be withdrawn (answers removed, tombstone kept). At most three per human, ever (Constitution, Article IV). Lives at registry/{registry_id}/versions/{1|2|3}.json.

version.description: 1, 2, or 3. A withdrawn version's slot stays spent.

questionnaire_version.description: Which questions/vN.json these answers respond to.

answers.description: Keyed by stable question id. Absent entirely when withdrawn — the words are genuinely gone from every copy.

text.description: Capped at 400 characters (POLICY.md; testimonies are written to the cap of their era).

visibility.description: Sealed answers enter the public record only on verified memorialization.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the original answers object (see schema/CANONICAL.md). Survives withdrawal.

signature.description: Optional in the founding era; reserved for when institution keys exist.
